# truefoundry_hashicorp_account (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry HashiCorp provider account carrying Vault KV secret store integrations, applied as a `provider-account/hashicorp` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Secret stores back TrueFoundry secret references like `my-tenant:hashicorp:my-account:secret-store:my-vault::path/value`. Existing accounts can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_hashicorp_account.example my-tenant:hashicorp:my-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Vault KV secret store with AppRole auth. Secret stores back TrueFoundry
# secret references like my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::path/value.
resource "truefoundry_hashicorp_account" "secrets" {
  name = "vault-secrets"

  vaults = [
    {
      name          = "vault"
      vault_url     = "https://vault.example.com"
      kv_mount_path = "de1/dev"
      root_path     = "tfy-control-plane"

      approle = {
        role_id   = "tfy-secret://my-tenant:system:vault-role-id"
        secret_id = "tfy-secret://my-tenant:system:vault-secret-id"
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the HashiCorp account (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the account.
- `vaults` (Attributes List) Vault KV secret stores accessible through this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the HashiCorp account.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the HashiCorp account.

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Required:

- `kv_mount_path` (String) Mount path of the KV secrets engine, e.g. secret or de1/dev.
- `name` (String) Name identifying this secret store integration.
- `vault_url` (String) Base URL of the Vault server, e.g. https://vault.example.com.

Optional:

- `approle` (Attributes) Vault AppRole auth. Exactly one of `token` and `approle` must be set. The control plane verifies the credentials against Vault at apply time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults--approle))
- `authorized_subjects` (Set of String) Subjects allowed to use this secret store, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.
- `namespace` (String) Vault Enterprise namespace to use.
- `root_path` (String) Path prefix within the KV mount under which secrets are read.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Vault token for token auth. Exactly one of `token` and `approle` must be set. The control plane verifies the credentials against Vault at apply time.

<a id="nestedatt--vaults--approle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults.approle`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) AppRole role ID. Accepts TrueFoundry secret references.
- `secret_id` (String, Sensitive) AppRole secret ID. Accepts TrueFoundry secret references.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# HashiCorp accounts are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:hashicorp:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_hashicorp_account.secrets my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets
```
